_carveout_note: #255: the bare-URL and exfil directive-gated long-bare-URL entries #252 added were REMOVED entirely (they false-fired on legitimate security findings that quote the same vocabulary an injected instruction would use). url now ships only visit/download-from, so this SSRF finding's title -- which legitimately quotes the offending URL itself -- stays KEPT trivially, not via any narrowing. See url_keeps_legit_nav_and_exfil_findings for the broader negative proof.

findings.description: This handler forwards the raw redirect_uri query parameter to an outbound fetch without validating it against an allowlist.
findings.title: SSRF: outbound fetch follows attacker-controlled redirect_uri=https://internal.example.com/api/v2/config/endpoint unchecked
